text:
Julia (Marketing): Heads up — SRE just flagged a cross-region latency spike. Need to align on status page wording & comms timeline. @Evan @Sam @Ryan
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created — High latency observed in eu-west starting 2026-03-21T14:03:00Z
Sam (Ops): Root cause suspected: DB conn pool exhaustion in proxy layer. Mitigations running (scale + restart). ETA 25–35m.
Evan (SRE): Confirmed. Scaled proxy instances, connections increasing. Latency trending down but still intermittent. Recommend status level: "Degraded performance" (avoid "Major outage").
Julia (Marketing): Good call. Draft two quick options for the status page copy: 
  Option A: "Degraded performance — we're observing increased latency in EU; remediation in progress."
  Option B: "Partial service disruption for some EU customers."
Which is less alarming but clear?
Ryan - CS: Option A. Also need a single-sentence email subject for affected customers: "Notice: Elevated latency in EU — we're mitigating"
Maya (Marketing Ops): Proposed timing: publish initial status update at T+10 (10m), follow-up at T+40, send customer email if still unresolved at T+90. Approve?
Sam (Ops): Timing approved from ops side. Please do not post to social until we confirm stable mitigation — hold tweets.
Julia (Marketing): Agreed on hold. Here's a succinct status we can post now (short):
  "We are experiencing degraded performance affecting some EU requests. Our team is actively mitigating; requests are processing with higher latency. We'll provide updates shortly. — Redwood Inference"
Evan (SRE): Add this line to the status page details: "Affected services: Inference API (eu-west). Impact: increased request latency; no data loss reported."
Ryan - CS: Add routing instruction for customers: "If your production workload is impacted, reply to this notice or open a priority support ticket and we'll escalate to engineering."
Maya (Marketing Ops): I'll prepare the status page update + email draft. Ping me for the customer list segmentation: Dedicated & Private come first. Also, inbound leads routing note: route any new demo/trial requests from EU to the EU sales rep queue and flag them for possible SLA questions.
Julia (Marketing): Thanks. Final ask: please give +1 on this copy so I can publish at :00:35 UTC.
Sam (Ops): +1
Evan (SRE): +1
Ryan - CS: +1
Maya (Marketing Ops): +1 — publishing on my mark.
Julia (Marketing): Publishing now. I'll post initial status, hold social, and trigger email if we hit T+90 unresolved. Will update thread with timestamps of publishes. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai at 2026-03-21T14:13:02Z
Julia (Marketing): Posted. Follow-up scheduled for 14:45 UTC.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Noted — prepping email template and customer segment list now.
Ryan - CS: I'll prepare a CS playbook snippet for affected customers (what to say, credits, and routing).
Evan (SRE): Keeping thread updated with mitigation progress. Will post root-cause and resolution timeline once complete.
